test_title: PYST 53: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The office management was __in dire straits__ after the financial crash.

options.text: To walk on already trodden paths

solution:
The correct answer is Option 2) i.e. **"In a very bad situation".**
